claim.scope: Finite quiescent Atomic/exact-MergeTree catalogs, selected Wide projection children and the measured six stock profiles plus affected guards.
claim.statement: OfflineTable exposes bounded typed projection windows through the existing child reader; full and window scans share one private admission owner.
claim.adversary_verdict: ROBUST within declared scope after first-parent defect rejection, native child-axis witnesses, exact CHECK-message auditor repair and coherent forgery rejection/restoration.
claim.F: Executed behavioral RED, compiling suites, stock raw audits and falsifiers; no formal proof.
claim.G: 37 affected spec files; six finite stock profiles, two resolved parents each, full/middle/cross-child/EOF/past-EOF windows. Not all layouts or live operation.
claim.R: Root inspected delegated changes and owned serialized jobs; Luna reviews are correlated, not independent replication. The raw auditor's CHECK gap was independently reproduced.

boundaries.risk: CAUTION: public storage consumer and shared admission extraction.
boundaries.rollback: Revert the exact-path atomic local feature commit without discarding unrelated work; no push or history rewrite.
admitted: Explicit declared projection windows in concatenated physical child-row order.
Complete resolved-parent child/schema preflight before any callback, even EOF/out-of-interval children.
Parent batch identity with child mark, mark-local, part-local and global-child row offsets.
Bounded positive max_rows; empty set start zero; EOF no callbacks; library past EOF BoundsError.
retained_guards: Direct MV access and non-exact-MergeTree engines.
Unsafe/undeclared names, duplicate/empty/oversized selections and invalid row limits.
Missing/symlink/malformed child and unsupported inherited specialized profiles.
Borrowed callback lifetime, existing per-mark memory budgets and complete specialized schedule validation.
not_claimed: Server Active/freshness, live consistent snapshot or query optimizer selection.
Parent/base fallback, general engines, projection execution or writing.
New type/layout admission, full repository suite, full compatibility or broad facade refactoring.
Performance work or <=10 percent stock-reader gap. Overall goal remains active.

architecture.law: Container serde delegates to child codecs; physical per-occurrence bindings and state schedules are separate from new leaf grammars or missing native qualification.
architecture.next_discriminator: Stock Wide Array(QBit(BFloat16,16)) with empty/uneven arrays across marks; Memory source witness does not qualify persisted support. Reuse existing leaf and preserve reader/writer parity.

source_reference.distinction: Shallow source and runtime executable are separate pins, not a same-build or continuing latest-master assertion.
